[[Grentchus Magnus]] is a [[Grentch]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Nebo Terrace]], [[The Underworld]] and the [[Secret Lair of the Snowmen]] during [[Wintersday]] [[quest]]s.

== Locations ==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Underworld]]
***{{NPC_location|Bone Pits}} (during the quest [[You're a Mean One, Mr. Grenth]]) (level 19)
*[[Prophecies]]
** [[Kryta]]
*** {{NPC_location|Nebo Terrace}} (during the quest [[The Greatest Snowman Ever Made]]) (level 20 / 29)
*[[Eye of the North]]
** [[Depths of Tyria]]
*** {{NPC_location|Secret Lair of the Snowmen}} (during the quests [[Straight to the Heart]] and [[The Strength of Snow]]) (level 19)
